evals.name: full-verb-listing
evals.prompt: What sidekicks CLI commands can I use? Give me the full list.
evals.expected_output: Runs `node bin/sidekicks --help` (not a global binary) and presents the real verb surface across project and service namespaces. No invented verbs.

evals.name: specific-verb-howto
evals.prompt: How do I create a new project called acme-platform using the sidekicks cli?
evals.expected_output: Identifies `node bin/sidekicks project create acme-platform` from live --help output. Signature matches `create <name>`.

evals.name: signature-precision
evals.prompt: What's the exact signature of `service add`? Does it take an optional name argument?
evals.expected_output: States the signature `add <git-url> [<name>]` with the optional name, sourced from live --help, no fabrication.
